assessment.security_status_en: Global tech markets were shaken by concerns following the rise of Chinese AI platform DeepSeek, triggering a sharp sell-off in US and Asian semiconductor equities and a flight to safe-haven assets like the Japanese yen. Simultaneously, Beijing is tightening domestic control through a massive anti-corruption campaign and stricter Chinese Communist Party discipline. Regional geopolitical tensions continue to escalate amid military pressure in the South China Sea and North Korean activities, including drone technology development and state-sponsored cyberattacks.
